Window types

Any type can be combined into a larger assembly for your opening.

Casement

Hinged on the side and cranks open outward. The best seal of any opening window — ideal for bedrooms and living rooms.

+ info

Awning

Hinged at the top, opens outward from the bottom. Can stay open in the rain; common above picture windows and in basements.

+ info

Picture (fixed)

Does not open. Maximum glass, maximum insulation value — often combined with casements or awnings on the sides.

+ info

The details that matter

Fusion-welded corners, steel-reinforced frames, multi-point locks and sealed glass units with warm-edge spacers. We choose profiles and glass for this climate, not for a catalogue.

  • Double or triple pane, Low-E, argon fill
  • White or laminated exterior colours and woodgrains
  • Integrated screens and internal grilles
  • Brickmould, jamb extensions and nailing fin to suit your wall
